notes: apps/agents-sandbox-coding-agent is the upstream folder at this commit, with the changes below. The source files are unchanged.
LICENSE is the license file of the upstream repository root. The example folder has none of its own.
In the upstream monorepo the workspace installs the dependencies. The copy installs on its own with bun, so it gets its own bun.lock.

just-bash is added: agents and @cloudflare/computer list it as an optional peer, and the app reaches agents/dist/skills/runner.js, which imports it. Without it the build fails with: [MISSING_EXPORT] "Bash" is not exported by "__vite-optional-peer-dep:just-bash:agents".
pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml come from an earlier install with pnpm. The harness does not use them.
